words.meaning: location suffix meaning side or surface

definition.title: Extend location and direction
definition.subtitle: Learn, understand, and use a Mandarin pattern.
definition.context: Use the introduced pattern in a bounded sentence. Other wording may be valid Chinese; this task checks this pattern and these words.

blocks.text: The learned 面 words name positions, including front, back, inside and outside; distinguish left from right. 从 can introduce an origin, a starting time or a chosen route. 往 points toward a direction and does not by itself assert arrival. With residence or position verbs such as 住 and 站, 在 + place follows the verb to state where the subject resides or is positioned; this does not license arbitrary postverbal locations with every action.

examples.meaning: The school is on the left and the station is on the right.
